apiKeyGuide.title: API Key Setup Guide
apiKeyGuide.bannerText: No API key configured — you need one to create learning paths.
apiKeyGuide.bannerCta: Learn how to get your API key
apiKeyGuide.intro: To generate personalized learning paths, this app uses Google's Gemini AI. You'll need a free API key to get started.
apiKeyGuide.whatIsTitle: What is a Gemini API key?
apiKeyGuide.whatIsBody: An API key is a unique code that lets this app communicate with Google's Gemini AI on your behalf. It's free to create and use within Google's free-tier limits.
apiKeyGuide.stepsTitle: How to get your API key
apiKeyGuide.step1Title: Sign in to Google AI Studio
apiKeyGuide.step1Body: Go to Google AI Studio and sign in with your Google account. If you don't have one, you can create one for free.
apiKeyGuide.step3Body: Click "Get API key" in the top-left menu, then click "Create API key". Select the default project or create a new one. Copy the generated key.
apiKeyGuide.step4Title: Add the key to this app
apiKeyGuide.step4Body: Go to Settings > API Keys in this app, paste your key into the input field, and click Save Key. You're all set!
apiKeyGuide.tipBody: Create a dedicated API key just for this app. Use Google's free-tier plan so there's zero cost. You can revoke the key anytime from Google AI Studio.

apiKeySecurity.title: API Key Security
apiKeySecurity.howWeStoreBody: Your API key is encrypted at rest using AES-256-GCM before it is saved to our database. It is never logged or stored in plaintext. Only the last four characters are retained unencrypted so you can identify which key is on file.
apiKeySecurity.noSystemBody: We take security seriously, but no online service can guarantee it will never be breached — even large companies like Sony PlayStation and many others have experienced data leaks. We believe in being transparent about this reality rather than making promises we cannot keep.
apiKeySecurity.dedicatedKeyBody: We strongly recommend generating a separate API key specifically for this application. That way, if you ever need to revoke it, you can do so without affecting your other projects or services.
apiKeySecurity.freeTierBody: Link your API key to Google's free-tier plan so that even in a worst-case breach scenario there is zero financial exposure. The free tier is sufficient for using this application.
apiKeySecurity.revokeBody: If you stop using this application, head over to Google AI Studio and delete the key you created for it. Keeping unused credentials active is an unnecessary risk.
